TEXT:
[FI] On my way home from school, I came across the 
sight of Sena loitering around a park bench.
[FI] What's she doing alone in a place like this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, good work today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Kousaka-senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's up? You were so energetic earlier...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ahaha...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...We still didn't come to a decision after that 
meeting.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that what you are brooding over?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Well, something like that. Lately, things haven't been 
going as planned... so that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Not going as planned?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yes... In that meeting, everyone just did as they 
pleased, and the meeting was over before we 
could even decide anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I am supposed to take charge and keep them 
focused during the meeting, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Since everyone is accepting of one another there, I 
ended up derailing the meeting by talking about 
my interests... This isn't good, is it?

[FI] Ah right, when she first joined the club, she was still 
hiding the fact that she's a fujoshi.

[FI] But because it was no longer necessary to hide it, 
she has been immersed in her delusions more often 
lately in front of us without discretion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, you're the type that wants everything to be 
done properly, so you would be bothered by that, 
but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Don't you think that being able to talk about your 
hobbies freely is a good thing?

[FI] Just like when Kirino, Kuroneko, and Saori are 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] The others will probably forget all about it after a 
night's sleep. Don't worry about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Is... that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you're still bothered by it, just try harder next 
time, got it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...Okay. Thank you.

[FI] Great, looks like she's feeling better. Now I can go 
home in relief.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then, I'll see you later.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] U-Um... Kousaka-senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Um...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Life counseling...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Could you give me some... [font_size=28]life counseling?[/font_size]

[FI] Hey now, you kidding me? I never imagined that a 
day would come where I would have life 
counseling with someone else's little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...Um, is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...No, it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Does this mean... no?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Sure, I'm free anyway. Wanna go somewhere else?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, no! Here is fine. Even though I said life 
counseling, it's not a topic that's serious...

[FI] Thank goodness... compared to Kirino's life 
counseling, this might be a breeze.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, of all the people I know, you're the only 
person that understands this topic the most.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You think way too highly of me.

[FI] She doesn't mean any harm but, that's a bit of 
pressure on me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So? What's the problem?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] The truth is...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]I find Onii-chan creepy.[/font_size]
[FI] ...I tested this out by calling Akagi then and there.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hey, what's up Kousaka?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, what do you think of your little sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] She's practically an angel! Why, you ask? It'll take 3 
hours to explain, but that's not a problem, huh? I'll 
start with when she was first born...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...No doubt, he is creepy.
[FI] Sena dropped her shoulders in disappointment.
